verdict.rationale: Lever's Automation Hub and Advanced Nurture features describe rule-based automations that run in the background (archiving, tagging, emailing, advancing candidates, automated re-engagement) without requiring manual triggering, and webhooks/API support event-driven automation. However, these are workflow/rule automations rather than AI-agentic autonomous processes, and there's no evidence of user-configurable AI agents that reason or adapt autonomously. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-driven (not just rule-based) autonomous decision-making, user-configurable agent workflows, and independent corroboration of reliability.
